name: workflow
description: Small helpers for the Claude Code workflow itself, such as skill-activation reminders and worktree setup

carry_paths.title: Paths to carry into worktrees
carry_paths.description: Repo-relative paths to copy from the main checkout into a new worktree. Nothing is carried until you list something here. A good starting set is CLAUDE.md, .env, .mcp.json, .claude/skills, .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, plus your own such as personal or docs/personal. Paths missing from a repo are skipped, so one list works across all your repos.
